title: aaas.envelope.v1
description: Envelope shared by every event published on Redpanda: identity, type and version, time, producing service, task, trace context and the type-specific payload. Event schemas reference it and narrow type, version, producer, taskId and payload.

eventId.description: Unique identifier of this event, a lowercase UUIDv7 (RFC 9562) generated by the producer. Consumers deduplicate on it (table processed_events, CLAUDE.md 4.2).

type.description: Event type: the topic name without the version suffix, `aaas.<entity>.<past-tense-verb>` (for the dead-letter topic: `aaas.dlq`).

version.description: Major version of the event; the topic is `<type>.v<version>`.

occurredAt.description: Instant the event happened, in UTC with millisecond precision (`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.sssZ`).

producer.description: Name of the producing service (CLAUDE.md section 2, kebab-case).

taskId.description: Addition task the event belongs to (UUIDv7, the message key), or null for an event that precedes the creation of a task (aaas.key.pressed.v1, keyed by session instead).

traceparent.description: W3C Trace Context `traceparent` of the span that produced the event (version 00); the trace and parent identifiers must not be all zeros.

payload.description: Type-specific content, defined by the schema of each event.

uuid.description: Lowercase UUID of any version (RFC 9562, canonical textual form).

uuidV7.description: Lowercase UUID version 7 with the RFC 9562 variant: time-ordered, so identifiers sort by creation time.

timestamp.description: UTC instant with exactly three fractional digits and the `Z` designator; the fixed form keeps hashes over timestamps reproducible.

operand.description: Operand of an addition: a non-negative integer in the supported range 0 to 99 999 (CLAUDE.md section 1).

sum.description: Result of an addition of two operands: a non-negative integer up to 199 998.

sha256.description: SHA-256 digest as 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.
